Complete immutable mobile packaging, signing, and verified delivery (#270)

* Add GitHub Actions OIDC verification for build stages

Verify pinned ES256 Actions tokens and issue short-lived stage credentials
without accepting the shared buildbox bearer as a substitute.

* Match GitHub OIDC workflow claims before issuing stage credentials

Accept workflow_ref and job_workflow_ref as owner/repo/path@ref, and refuse
a credential when the verified job workflow is not the requested stage.

* Fail closed on buildbox OIDC exchange without a dispatch binding.

Register POST /api/v1/buildbox/auth/exchange so an unconfigured trust
store or an unbound attempt cannot mint a stage credential. The shared
service bearer is not accepted as a substitute.

* Bind buildbox OIDC exchange to a dispatched attempt.

Verify the Actions token against the fixed JWKS cache and record the
GitHub run on the platform attempt. Prepared runs and GitHub reruns
fail closed instead of minting a stage credential.

* Restrict build Spec reads and upload grants to stage credentials.

Prepare may read a dispatched Spec without an upload URL. Finalize alone
can request an artifact upload, and the shared service bearer cannot take
either path.

* Dispatch a prepared GitHub attempt with only the platform run id.

A missing token, repository id, or approved SHA leaves dispatch closed. An accepted workflow_dispatch records dispatched without inventing a run URL, and an unknown network result stays dispatching so a retry does not send a second event.

* Add recoverable verification jobs for distribution artifacts.

Callbacks still only declare size and digest. A leased job records each
target, and downloads point at the protected copy once verification passes.

* Enqueue artifact verification and reject GitHub shared-bearer callbacks.

A succeeded callback queues one verification job per declared target in the
same transaction. A GitHub attempt requires a finalize stage credential even
when the trusted repository id is still empty, so the shared bearer cannot
complete it.

* Hash verified distribution artifacts from the protected object copy.

Decrypt the published storage credential, copy the attempt-scoped upload, and stream its SHA-256 before promotion. Downloads require the recorded protected key.

* Complete immutable mobile packaging and isolated signing orchestration

* Scope foreign-key migration preservation test to its exact migration

* Use AWS-LC JWT backend to remove vulnerable RSA dependency

* Fix build lint findings and isolate reconciliation fixture
